name: How long does remodel painting take for an interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does remodel painting take for an interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for remodel painting depends on the room size, ceiling height, and the extent of necessary drywall prep. A standard bedroom or bathroom remodel typically requires two to three days for patching, priming, two finish coats, and trim detailing. A full basement or multi-room open floor plan can take four to seven working days. The process includes surface masking, proper dry times between primer and color coats, and final inspection touch-ups after all surrounding construction dust has settled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most single-room projects take two to three days, while full basement or multi-room renovations generally take four to seven days depending on drywall prep and dry times.
